title: AlphaStar Achieves Grandmaster Level in StarCraft II via Multi-Agent RL
whyItMatters: First AI to reach Grandmaster level (top 0.15% of human players) across all three races in StarCraft II—mastering real-time combinatorial planning under imperfect information and non-transitive strategy.
summary: Oriol Vinyals, Igor Babuschkin, Wojciech Czarnecki, David Silver, and the Google DeepMind team published AlphaStar in Nature (2019), conquering real-time strategy game StarCraft II—a benchmark far beyond board games due to partial observability ("fog of war"), real-time continuous-discrete action spaces (~10²⁶ actions per frame), and rock-paper-scissors strategic cycles. Bootstrapped from human replays and refined via a novel population-based league of main agents and adversarial exploiters, AlphaStar played anonymously on Europe’s live Battle.net ladder under human camera and APM constraints, reaching Grandmaster (above 99.8% of ranked human players) for Protoss, Terran, and Zerg.
technicalHighlights: Introduced league-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (Main Agents, Main Exploiters, League Exploiters) to overcome non-transitive strategic cycles.
Achieved official Grandmaster status (top 0.15% of ~90,000 European Battle.net players) across all three asymmetric races under human-comparable APM and camera constraints.
Combined Transformer entity encoders, deep LSTMs, and autoregressive pointer networks over combinatorial real-time action spaces.
caveats: Required large-scale imitation pretraining on ~971,000 human replays before RL self-play and struggled against unseen cheese strategies outside its training map pool.

scoreRationale.foundational: Solved real-time, imperfect-information, combinatorial multi-agent planning with league-based RL.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly influenced game-theoretic RL (DeepNash, Cicero), open-ended multi-agent training, and real-time decision systems.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Nature and verified blindly against human players on official Battle.net Grandmaster ladders.
scoreRationale.velocity: Synthesized centuries of equivalent StarCraft II match experience in 44 days of TPU league training.
